Balance Sheet March 2025 | website = moneycontrol.com | publisher = Money Control}} | equity = | num_employees = 14,265 (2025) | ratio = | hq_location = [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]], India | key_people = [[R Subramaniakumar]] ([[Managing director|MD]] & [[Chief executive officer|CEO]]) | website = {{URL|https://www.rbl.bank.in/}} }} '''RBL Bank ('''formerly known as '''Ratnakar Bank Limited).''' is an [[Private sector banks in India|Indian private sector bank]] founded in 1943 and headquartered in [[Mumbai]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.rblbank.com/about-us|title=About Us|website=www.rblbank.com|accessdate=24 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220506134700/https://www.rblbank.com/about-us|archive-date=6 May 2022|url-status=dead}} It offers services across five verticals: corporate banking, commercial banking, branch banking and retail liabilities, retail assets, and treasury and financial markets operations.{{cite web|title=RBL Bank toIPO|url=http://www.bankingservices/news/banking/2023/01/01/pe-backed-rbl-bank-files-exit|publisher=Banking Services|access-date=1 Jan 2023|date=1 Jan 2023}}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} In June 2026, [[Emirates NBD]] acquired a 60% stake in the bank.{{cite web |title=Emirates NBD and RBL Bank announce the Successful Completion of the Landmark Strategic Investment |url=https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/media-center/emirates-nbd-and-rbl-bank-announce-landmark-strategic-investment |website=Emirates NBD |access-date=23 July 2026 |language=en}} == History == On 6 August 1943, Ratnakar Bank was founded as a regional bank in [[Maharashtra]] with two branches in [[Kolhapur]] and [[Sangli]] by Babgonda Bhujgonda Patil from Sangli and Gangappa Siddappa Chougule from Kolhapur. It mainly served [[Small and medium-sized enterprises|small and medium enterprises]] (SMEs) and business merchants in the Kolhapur-Sangli belt. The bank was incorporated in [[Kolhapur district]] on 14 June 1943 as Ratnakar Bank Limited.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/articleshow/6129247.cms|title=Ratnakar Bank gets new-look board|last=M|first=Sabarinath|date=2010-07-05|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-09-21}}{{Cite news |url= https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/rbl-bank-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-7750.cms|title= Company History - RBL Bank Ltd.|access-date= February 15, 2019|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com |publisher=[[The Economic Times]]}} In 1959, the bank was categorized as a [[Scheduled Banks (India)|scheduled commercial bank]] as per the [[Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934]]. During this decade, it was referred to as an NH4 Bank. In 1970, it received a banking license from the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI).{{Cite news |url= https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/ratnakar-bank-from-nh4-to-nh8-112112300028_1.html|title= Ratnakar Bank: From NH4 to NH8|first= Somasroy|last= Chakraborty|date= January 20, 2013|access-date= February 15, 2019|website=business-standard.com |publisher=[[Business Standard]]}} In 2013, Ratnakar Bank acquired [[Royal Bank of Scotland]]'s business banking, mortgage, and credit cards business divisions in India.{{cite news |title=Ratnakar Bank to buy 3 business units of RBS |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/ratnakar-bank-to-buy-3-business-units-of-rbs/article64211841.ece |access-date=25 October 2025 |work=BusinessLine |date=9 August 2013 |language=en}} In August 2014, the name of the bank was changed to RBL Bank Limited. RBL Bank was registered and listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange ([[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]]) on August 31,2016, following its initial public offering ([[Initial public offering|IPO]]){{Cite web | url=https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/ipo/PRICE_BAND_AD_RBLBANK_120820161515.pdf | title=RBL bank limited | website=www.bseindia.com}} On 12 June 2022, [[R Subramaniakumar]] was appointed as the Managing Director and CEO of the bank.{{cite web |title=Who is R Subramaniakumar, the new MD & CEO of RBL Bank? |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/banks/who-is-r-subramaniakumar-the-new-md-ceo-of-rbl-bank-8673511.html |website=Moneycontrol}} RBL Bank announced integration of [[Unified Payments Interface|UPI]] and [[National Common Mobility Card]] capabilities with [[RuPay]] credit cards on 1 August 2024.{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Ayush |date=1 August 2024 |title=RBL Bank launches RuPay credit cards with UPI and NCMC functionalities |url=https://www.business-standard.com/finance/personal-finance/rbl-bank-launches-rupay-credit-cards-with-upi-and-ncmc-functionalities-124080100990_1.html |access-date=4 August 2024 |website=Business Standard}} On 18 October 2025, [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]]-based bank [[Emirates NBD]] announced that it will acquire a 60% stake in RBL Bank for {{currency|26850|INR}} crore ({{USD|3.05}} billion) through a preferential issue of shares.{{Cite web |date=2026-04-30 |title=India's markets regulator approves change of control at RBL Bank in Emirates NBD stake deal |url=https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/indias-markets-regulator-approves-change-control-rbl-bank-emirates-nbd-stake-2026-04-30/ |website=[[Reuters]]}} In June 2026, it completed the acquisition for {{USD|2.75}} billion.{{cite web |last1=Sarkar|first1=Suvo |title=Emirates NBD's RBL Bank deal rewrites the UAE-India banking corridor |url=https://gulfnews.com/business/analysis/emirates-nbds-275b-rbl-bank-deal-marks-a-turning-point-for-uae-india-finance-1.500582319 |website=Gulf News: Latest UAE news, Dubai news, Business, travel news, Dubai Gold rate, prayer time, cinema |access-date=22 June 2026 |language=en |date=22 June 2026}} ==Operations== As of 2026, it has a network of 628 branches{{Cite web |title=About Us {{!}} RBL Bank |url=https://www.rbl.bank.in/about-us |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=www.rbl.bank.in}} across 28 states and union territories. It has 14,265 employees.{{Cite web |title=RBL Annual Report FY 2024-25, Page 77 |url=https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/annual_reports/AR_27955_RBLBANK_2024_2025_A_14300733_30082025161607.pdf |website=NSE India}} The bank also has a network of 1,272 business correspondent branches, of which 952 are managed by RBL Finserve Limited.{{cite web |date=27 April 2024 |title=RBL Bank Q4 results: Standalone PAT jumps 30% YoY to Rs 353 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/rbl-bank-q4-results-standalone-pat-jumps-30-yoy-to-rs-353-crore/articleshow/109643607.cms |website=The Economic Times}} In 2018, RBL Bank partnered with MoneyTap to launch India's first personal credit line-based app.{{Cite news |last=Bhakta |first=Pratik |date=2017-05-23 |title=Moneytap, RBL Bank to offer line-of-credit to small units |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/moneytap-rbl-bank-to-offer-line-of-credit-to-small-units/articleshow/58801319.cms |access-date=2018-11-07}} In June of the same year, the company announced that it had raised its stake in microlender Swadhaar FinServe to 100 per cent.{{Cite web |date=28 June 2018 |title=RBL Bank buys 100% stake in Swadhaar FinServe |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/rbl-bank-buys-100-stake-in-swadhaar-finserve/article24281525.ece}} ===Funding=== Between 2010 and 2020, the bank raised equity and debt capital from several investors, including Barings Private Equity Asia,{{cite news |last1=Rebello |first1=Joel |title=Investors led by Baring PE put Rs 1566 crore into RBL Bank |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/investors-led-by-baring-pe-put-rs-1566-crore-into-rbl-bank/articleshow/77656774.cms}}{{cite news |last1=Dhanjal |first1=Swaraj Singh |date=21 August 2020 |title=Baring PE, others to invest ₹1,566 crore in RBL Bank |language=en |work=Livemint |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/baring-pe-others-to-invest-1-566-crore-in-rbl-bank-11597971135171.html}} British International Investment (formerly CDC Group), Multiples Alternate Asset Management, the Asian Development Bank, HDFC Ltd., ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, and Gaja Capital.{{Cite web |date=7 July 2017 |title=RBL Bank to raise $260 mn from Multiples PE, CDC and others |url=https://www.vccircle.com/rbl-bank-to-raise-260-mn-from-multiples-pe-cdc-and-others}} ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[Banking in India]] * [[List of banks in India]] * [[List of extract:
RBL Bank (formerly known as Ratnakar Bank Limited). is an Indian private sector bank founded in 1943 and headquartered in Mumbai. It offers services across five verticals: corporate banking, commercial banking, branch banking and retail liabilities, retail assets, and treasury and financial markets operations.
In June 2026, Emirates NBD acquired a 60% stake in the bank.
